subsystems.name: Bioreactor train
subsystems.role: grows engineered yeast or fungi that secrete the target protein into the broth.

subsystems.name: Upstream media preparation
subsystems.role: supplies sterile sugar, nitrogen and vitamin feed to the culture.

subsystems.name: Downstream processing
subsystems.role: separates the protein from cells and broth, then purifies it to food grade.

subsystems.name: Strain and culture management
subsystems.role: keeps the production organism high-yielding and free of contamination.

subsystems.name: Utilities and building integration
subsystems.role: fits fermentation into an urban building with power, heat, water and waste handling.

subsystems.name: Automation and control
subsystems.role: maintains sterile conditions and consistent output.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the production organism
buildSteps.detail: Genes for a milk or egg protein are inserted into yeast or filamentous fungi, and high-yielding strains are selected in the lab.

buildSteps.title: Design the bioreactor train
buildSteps.detail: Vessels are sized from seed scale to thousands of litres, with sterile aeration and cooling to match the building's footprint.

buildSteps.title: Prepare the building
buildSteps.detail: Floors are reinforced for heavy vessels, and steam, chilled water, power and waste lines are brought to the fermentation suite.

buildSteps.title: Install upstream and downstream modules
buildSteps.detail: Media preparation, fermentation, separation, purification and drying skids are assembled and connected.

buildSteps.title: Integrate utilities and automation
buildSteps.detail: The plant is tied into city power and water, and sensors, CIP and control systems are commissioned.

buildSteps.title: Validate and approve
buildSteps.detail: Sterile water and fermentation runs prove reproducibility, and food-safety regulators approve the product.

buildSteps.title: Operate continuously
buildSteps.detail: Sugar feed is delivered, broth is harvested, protein is purified, and waste and cleaning are managed daily.

prerequisites.why: used commercially for rennet and some enzymes, but large-scale food-protein production is still limited.
standard in pharmaceutical and food-enzyme manufacturing.
urban plants need a reliable local supply of sugars or organic waste.
purifying proteins at food cost and volume is harder than at pharmaceutical scale.
approvals exist in some countries for specific proteins but are not universal.
cities rarely allow fermentation plants with their heat, odour and waste loads.

pathway.milestone: precision fermentation plants making rennet, enzymes and some dairy proteins at industrial sites
pathway.unlocks: proof that engineered microbes can make food proteins at commercial scale.

pathway.milestone: pilot urban bio-foundries in modular containers or building basements
pathway.unlocks: data on running fermentation close to consumers.

pathway.milestone: district-scale bio-foundries using waste heat and organic waste
pathway.unlocks: circular urban food production with lower transport emissions.

pathway.milestone: networks of urban bio-foundries supplying a meaningful share of local protein
pathway.unlocks: resilient city food systems less dependent on distant farms.
